review.reviewer: Codex source inspection before model execution, 17 October 2026
review.method: Expected facts and sufficient passage IDs read from retained narrative before retrieval or answer outputs. Final independent Spec review verifies all mappings.

grouping: Shared story events and derived questions remain in the same development group across biographies. All cases exposed; no train/holdout split or independent sample-size claim.

scoring.matching: Snapshot-local passage IDs, deduplicated before top-k. Labels identify selected sufficient spans, not exhaustive passage relevance.
scoring.retrieval_denominator: Selected labelled relevant passages; zero-relevance cases have null recall/hit/MRR.
scoring.context_denominator: Required facts with a complete sufficient set in actual assembled context; no facts gives null coverage and insufficient context.
scoring.acceptance: Each profile has at least one reviewed sourced answer; gaps and all measured retrieval/context failures are published. No aggregate held-out or calibrated quality threshold is claimed.
